globalLaws: Every rendered value is selected from a canonical field reference and retains its declared content state.
CONTENT_READY is the only static customer-copy state; SOURCE_BOUND and EDITORIAL_CHOICE remain owner-review only.
PENDING_EVIDENCE_BINDING carries no factual value except an explicitly constrained unavailable state.
Evidence language is record-specific and source-reported; labels, renders and OpenLab values remain separate authority layers.
Commerce is a WOO_C2 runtime resolver only and may not be represented by a template value, fallback, CTA or structured-data Offer.
A missing render remains an unpopulated governed chamber; it never borrows another product or studio asset.

families.name: Discovery
families.scope: Reusable browse, search, collection, commercial-card and comparison-entry composition. This is a template family, not a route list.
families.audience: Customers identifying and comparing labelled products before a product decision.

slots.customerBehavior: Render unambiguous identity; optional aliases and series may be omitted.
slots.missingBehavior: Do not render a product card when canonical identity is unresolved.

slots.customerBehavior: Use only the confirmed transparent final render in the governed card chamber.
slots.missingBehavior: Render the unpopulated chamber; never substitute another product or studio view.

slots.customerBehavior: Use one approved compact label-backed summary.
slots.missingBehavior: Omit narrative rather than promote source-bound or editorial draft copy.

slots.customerBehavior: Show available evidence only where bound; otherwise present the explicit unavailable state.
slots.missingBehavior: Never borrow a record, provider action or generic verified label.

responsiveBehavior.desktop: Cards retain identity, render and discrete evidence state without conflating them.
responsiveBehavior.mobile: Preserve identity and state; compact narrative may omit but cannot change meaning.

families.name: Product
families.scope: Reusable product-decision, dossier and source-record composition. This is a template family, not a route list.
families.audience: Customers reviewing a labelled product and its separately bounded source record.

slots.customerBehavior: Pair exact identity with its confirmed transparent final render.
slots.missingBehavior: Leave media unpopulated or suppress the unresolved product module.

slots.customerBehavior: Mount approved long copy only in the dedicated narrative region and retain all source qualifiers.
slots.missingBehavior: Omit the affected narrative block; never expand compact or source-bound copy into long form.

slots.customerBehavior: Use labelled definition rows and explicitly incomplete composition wording.
slots.missingBehavior: Omit unready rows and never infer excipients, formula or dosage.

slots.customerBehavior: Separate source-reported batch values from label facts and retain record qualifiers.
slots.missingBehavior: Render explicit unavailable state only; do not manufacture a report, result, file or verdict.

slots.customerBehavior: Mount only fully bound customer FAQs with source-scope answers.
slots.missingBehavior: Omit the FAQ group when no approved entries exist.

responsiveBehavior.desktop: Keep narrative, facts, composition and evidence in distinct modules.
responsiveBehavior.mobile: Collapse information progressively while preserving labels, qualifiers and explicit unavailable states.
